release_notes:
Add category group icons, service tile redesign, fix profile save

Category group icons:
- New CategoryImage column on tbl_gf_package_category (IMEI/File) and
  tbl_gf_log_package_category (Server).
- admincp/category.php: upload/replace/remove a group icon when editing an
  IMEI or Server category, resized server-side to fit within 300x300.
- Customer-facing service listings (services.php, serverservices.php,
  fileservices.php and their template1 renderers, plus placeorder.php /
  placeorder_gf.php) now show an icon per service: the service's own image
  if set, else its category's group icon, else (on the placeorder.php tile
  view) a generic two-letter initials avatar derived from the category name.

placeorder.php tile redesign:
- Horizontal card layout (icon left, title/price/time right) instead of
  vertical icon-on-top; title clamped to 2 lines; price shown as a solid
  pill badge to match.

Fix: profile save silently failing:
- myprofile.php's UPDATE referenced Address2, a column that never existed
  on tbl_gf_users, so every profile save (not just the Order Page Style
  field) was failing with "Unknown column" — swallowed silently, no error
  shown to the user. Added the missing column via migration; also fixes
  the same latent bug in submitpayment.php and addcredits_gf.php, which
  reference the same column.

Docs:
- docs/local-development.md corrected: there is no DB auto-seed script,
  the app connects to fstunlck_tmp_2 (not "gsmtool"), and `down -v` wipes
  the volume with nothing to restore it — documented the real credential-
  reset steps instead of a stale example login that doesn't exist in the
  seed data.
